Steigt mit der Stufe (+2 bis +6). Er kom: Rises with level (+2 to +6). It is added to every roll the character is proficient in: attacks with proficient weapons, proficient skills and saving throws, spell attacks and spell save DC.

Jeder Zauber ab Grad 1 verbraucht einen: Every spell of level 1 or higher uses a slot of its level or higher. A higher slot often makes the spell stronger. Clicking a slot marks it as used. A long rest restores all of them.
Hexenmeister haben wenige Plätze, die al: Warlocks have few slots, all of the same, highest level, and they come back after a short rest.
Fernkampfwaffen mit der Eigenschaft Muni: Ranged weapons with the ammunition property use one piece per attack. After the fight you can recover half of the ammunition used.

Ritualzauber können ohne Zauberplatz gew: Ritual spells can be cast without a spell slot if you take 10 minutes longer, as long as the class can cast rituals.

Du hast so viele Glückspunkte wie dein Ü: You have as many luck points as your proficiency bonus (back after a long rest). For one point you have advantage on one of your own d20 rolls or give an attack against you disadvantage.
Two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from the list in brackets (cleric, druid or wizard). You can cast the level 1 spell once per long rest without a spell slot, otherwise with your spell slots. Dietriche, Feile und Spiegel: Schlösser: Picks, file and mirror: opening locks and disarming traps.

Stein bearbeiten, Mauern bauen und Schwa: Working stone, building walls and spotting weak points in masonry.
Shaping and firing vessels of clay.
